Name: Party Info - Multiplayer Status
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b]Party Info[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Multiplayer overlay, Off-screen Player locator, player health, energy, location, skills, status notifications.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Player Head Overlay[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*][size=3]Displays head portraits of all connected players along the top, left, or right edge of the screen.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Toggle visibility with a configurable keybind. [color=#b4a7d6](default LeftAlt + C)[/color][/size][/*]
[*]Offline players show a red Offline label, They can be hidden entirely via the [color=#b4a7d6]Show Offline [/color]toggle.[/*]
[*][size=3]Show your own head with the [color=#b4a7d6]Show Self[/color] toggle.[/size][/*]
[/list][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Top Position Layout[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784114701-352725343.gif[/img][/center]
[left][size=4][b]Left Position Layout[/b][/size]
[spoiler][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784114690-1482354187.gif[/img][/center]
[/spoiler]
[/left]
[left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Off-Screen Player Locator[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]Shows a pin at the screen edge pointing toward players outside your view, with a head icon and distance.[/*]
[*]Horses can be located with the Horse Locator option.[/*]
[*]Fully customizable: [color=#b4a7d6]always [/color]on or [color=#b4a7d6]hold-only[/color] mode with a configurable keybind [color=#b4a7d6](default: C)[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]locator [/color]and head [color=#b4a7d6]icon scale[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]edge offset[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]arrow gap[/color], and [color=#b4a7d6]distance[/color] are configurable.[/*]
[/list][center][img width=556]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1786793356-1138852272.png[/img][/center]
[left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Status Notifications[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]Notifications appear below heads with priority ordering: [color=#e06666]Knocked Out[/color], [color=#ea9999]Critical [/color][color=#ffffff]or[/color] [color=#6aa84f]Exhausted[/color].
[center][color=#e06666][b]Knocked Out[/b][/color] - health reaches zero.[/center]
Critical - health drops below a configurable threshold. (default 30%)Exhausted - stamina drops below a configurable threshold. (default 10%)[/*]
[*]Each notification type has its own GMCM sub-page with settings for [color=#b4a7d6]duration[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]fade timing[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]shake direction[/color] and [color=#b4a7d6]intensity[/color].[/*]
[*]Notifications can be suppressed while hovering over a head (Mute Notifications toggle, [color=#b4a7d6]default on[/color]). Mute lasts a configurable duration. [color=#b4a7d6](default 10s)[/color][/*]
[/list][spoiler][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784115035-1719233849.gif[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48739/48739-1784114695-760319026.gif[/img][/center]
[/spoiler]
[left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Persistent Status[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]Location[/b] [/color]- shows the player's current area name, including custom locations added by mods, using the game's display name where available. Green for safe zones, red for dangerous areas.[/*]
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]Health[/b] [/color]- shows current and max health as numbers inside a health bar.[/*]
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]Energy[/b] [/color]- shows current and max stamina as numbers inside an energy bar.[/*]
[*]A black background box behind status text can be enabled with configurable transparency (Status BG, default on at 15% alpha).[/*]
[/list][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Custom Colors[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]Health bar, energy bar, location text, profession and XP text use two configurable colors: Red Color and Green Color, entered as hex codes in the config menu.[/*]
[*]Red applies to the health bar, dangerous locations, the offline label, and critical notifications.[/*]
[*]Green applies to the energy bar, safe locations, the online label, profession and XP text.[/*]
[/list][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Tooltips[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]Hover over a head to show a tooltip box with [color=#b4a7d6]stat bars [/color]and [color=#b4a7d6]location[/color].[/*]
[*]Tooltip shows the player name with status tags inline. [color=#b4a7d6](Knocked Out, Critical, Exhausted, Offline)[/color][/*]
[*]Location line below the bars shows the player's current area, using the game's display name for modded locations where applicable.[/*]
[/list][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Skill Tooltips[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]Hold the Skills Key [color=#b4a7d6](default: Left Shift)[/color] while hovering to transition from [color=#b4a7d6]stat tooltips[/color] to [color=#b4a7d6]skill tooltips[/color].[/*]
[*]Shows Farming, Mining, Foraging, Fishing, and Combat and modded skills' levels.[/*]
[*]The right column of each skill row shows [color=#b4a7d6]profession names[/color] or [color=#b4a7d6]XP progress.[/color] [color=#b4a7d6](defaults to XP)[/color][/*]
[*]A [color=#b4a7d6]mastery row[/color] appears below the skills list once mastery progress exists, showing the mastery icon, level, and current XP progress.[/*]
[*]Profession names are listed under each skill. Supports vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] custom skill professions, including custom professions added by mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url].[/*]
[*]Compatibility with Vanilla Plus Professions shows profession names and XP for levels 15 and 20. [color=#b4a7d6](every mod has its xp curve hardcoded)[/color][/*]
[/list][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Show All Mode[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]Hold the [color=#b4a7d6]Show All Key (default: C)[/color] to display tooltips for all players simultaneously.[/*]
[*]Spacing between heads expands dynamically.[/*]
[*]Expand and collapse animations have separate configurable speeds (Expand Speed, Collapse Speed).[/*]
[/list][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Health and Energy Sync[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]Broadcasts local health and energy data every 15 ticks via SMAPI messaging.[/*]
[*]All tooltips and notification triggers read synced data for remote players, ensuring accurate readings.[/*]
[/list][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Time Control Integration[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*]When [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49186]Time Control[/url] (yousv.TimeControl) is installed, players who have voted to pause show a yellow Paused label on their head.[/*]
[*]Pause state is synced from the host to all clients via SMAPI messaging.[/*]
[*]Toggle with the Time Control option. [color=#b4a7d6](default on)[/color][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49186]Time Control[/url] [/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions - VPP[/url][/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url] [/size][/b][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348][size=4][b]SpaceCore[/b][/size][/url][size=4] Professions + Skills. [/size][size=3](tested with Yet Another Cooking Skill, Archaeology, Wizardry)[/size][/center]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 3.18.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.[/*]
[/list]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49186]Time Control[/url] for Paused status integration.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
